raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pendulum
  version: 3.3.0

package:
  name: pendulum
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/pendulum-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9aceb5b24e9f55381df08187397e88546b5ba82f698b741cbf1a05c5e2369116

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - maturin >=1.0,<2.0
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - maturin >=1.0,<2.0
  run:
    - python
    - python-dateutil >=2.6
    - python-tzdata >=2020.1
tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pendulum
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "from pendulum._pendulum import parse_iso8601"
      - python -c "from pendulum._helpers import days_in_year"

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
    - LICENSE
  summary: Python datetimes made easy
  description: |
    Drop-in replacement for the standard datetime class.
    It behaves exactly like it but with many improvements.
  homepage: https://pendulum.eustace.io
  repository: https://github.com/sdispater/pendulum
  documentation: https://pendulum.eustace.io/docs/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
    - xylar
